svg.title: Three ways to connect a phone and a laptop in the same room
svg.desc: A cloud service needs the internet and data leaves the room. WebRTC can send data directly, but connecting needs a signaling server online. Local Peer-to-Peer connects directly, authenticated, and works offline.

g.font-family: 'LP2P Inter', Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

text.tspan: Data can go direct, but connecting

text.font-family: 'LP2P Mono', 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
